verdict.rationale: An LLM gateway with usage analytics could plausibly offer AI-generated insights on a user's account or usage data, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only plain usage analytics and an MCP server that lets an external assistant pull account data. Neither is an AI-insights or suggestions feature inside OpenRouter itself, so both are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
